name: PR overview shows the seeded Why + Risk brief
description: From PR #482, stay on the default Overview tab and confirm the three brief surfaces render the SEEDED pr_brief row (server/src/db/seed.ts): the PR BRIEF banner with its `why` paragraph and risk badge, the RISK AREAS block inside the Intent card, and the Review focus list. Exercises PrBriefCard + RiskAreas + ReviewFocus + usePrBrief → GET /pulls/:id/brief. READ-ONLY BY DESIGN: both click-driven cases — expanding a risk row, and clicking a focus row to land on that file in the Files-changed tab — were removed on 2026-08-14 after failing in CI while passing every local reproduction. Do not re-add either without a reproduction; see INSIGHTS.md for what was ruled out. Read-only seeded data: the flow never clicks Regenerate, because a live generation needs a model key and e2e runs without one. The brief must NOT be labelled stale — the seed writes the PR's own head_sha and points review_id at the seeded review — which is asserted by the absence of the stale marker. The risk ref asserted below (src/config.ts) is deliberately also a row in the Files-changed tab: that is the grounding gate's promise checked end to end, not just the card's rendering. The expand-on-click step below was removed on 2026-08-14 and restored the same day: it had failed in a run sharing its agent-browser session with a second, forgotten one, and passed 11/11 once the session was exclusive — see INSIGHTS.md before concluding anything from it failing again. Note the refs are asserted while the row is COLLAPSED, so the grounding assertion never depends on the click. Text is matched in its RENDERED case — section labels are uppercased by CSS text-transform and agent-browser matches innerText. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
